_selection.seat_incumbents: Three of the four models registry/SEATS.md names are pinned. anthropic/claude-fable-5 is EXCLUDED — see _fable_excluded.
_selection.spread: 3 vendors at frontier tier, 4 open-weight mid, 2 small, 1 reasoning stressor.

_fable_excluded.reason_1: SKILL.md was developed with this model. Probing the doctrine against the model that wrote it measures recall, not doctrine-following — the memorised-compliance failure that P2's phrasing rotation exists to prevent, at the scale of the whole battery.
_fable_excluded.reason_2: Deployment reality: students will not pay frontier-auditor rates, so a qualification verdict for this seat would not describe any seat anyone fills.
_fable_excluded.consequence: The auditor row of the SEATS.md matrix stays OPEN after this battery. It is not closed and must not be reported as closed. google/gemini-3.1-pro-preview and openai/gpt-5.2 run the auditor-relevant probes (P3, P7) as candidates, which is a different claim.

_judge_note: Outside the roster by construction — the harness refuses to let a model grade its own output. Cheap ($0.40/$1.60 per M) and reliable at short JSON rubrics. Used only by P5 and P7, the two probes whose pass criteria are genuinely semantic.

_cost_estimate._method: Measured token shape, not a guess: skill-edition system prompt ~4.2K tokens, mechanics-card ~0.4K; P6 is 4 turns and P7 is 2, both resending their prefix. ~49.5K input + ~3.8K output per model per run.
_cost_estimate.at_n3_total_usd: ~3.45 before Anthropic prompt caching (was ~5.50 with fable-5)
_cost_estimate.ceiling: budget_usd in run_request.json. The harness accumulates usage.cost and aborts on crossing it, keeping partial results.
_cost_estimate.caveat: deepseek-r1 bills reasoning tokens as output; its real cost may run several times the line estimate. The ceiling is what actually bounds this, not the estimate.

_discount_roster_note: Discount window arm, pinned 2026-07-31 from the price diff between registry/probe_runs/30484858384-catalog (367 models, 2026-07-29) and registry/probe_runs/30672191114-catalog (336 models, 2026-07-31). Eleven models were cheaper than the pin; these five were selected. Separate key so the pinned roster stays untouched and Arm 1 remains comparable to run 30485884822. These models are NOT qualified for any seat and no seat verdict may cite them — the same bound spike_models carries. max_tokens is set per entry because P6 runs four turns; the thinking model gets 3000 for the reason deepseek-r1 does, which is that reasoning tokens bill as output. A discount is a price, not a capability: nothing here is claimed about these models until their cells exist.
